Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class DealStore

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.DealStore
public class DealStore extends Object
Deal requests and deals. All state changes go through lifecycle(); after every transition this store saves the listing's requests, deals and status to the deal_requests, deals and listings tables, and load(com.hkust.marketplace.utils.UserStore, com.hkust.marketplace.utils.ListingStore) rebuilds them at startup. Otherwise it only answers queries for the portals.
